reviewed_records.label: Forward
reviewed_records.depicts: A right-facing arrow or forward navigation cue.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show a forward action or a move to the next screen, panel, or step.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface moves to the next screen, panel, or navigation level.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for send or submit when the action is not actual forward navigation.

reviewed_records.label: Phone Transfer
reviewed_records.depicts: A control symbol used for state changes, refresh, or interaction handling.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show a system control action or a reversible interface action.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface applies a direct control action or changes a local system state.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for navigation or passive status when the meaning is an active control action.
